name: ANSI/IEEE recording wattmeter symbol
summary: IEEE-oriented graphical reference for recording wattmeter, with public vendor evidence and drawing-reading notes.
description: The recording-wattmeter form identifies active-power measurement with a documented recording function. The schematic supplies the measurement inputs; recording interval, retained history and sign convention are configured instrument information.

This is a convention-specific lookup based on the publisher's IEEE-labelled preview. The geometry here is independently drawn to explain the connection or operation; it is not a certified reproduction of the standard graphic.
readingNotes: Check phase inputs and import/export direction together.
Read the selected library and the project legend together. A vendor block identifier is meaningful within its named library and is not a universal standard-symbol code.
distinction: Recorded power and accumulated energy are different measurement records.
